classes.name: EDG - Ride Into Zen: A Resiliency Ride: + Meditation
classes.description: This 60-minute cycle experience is more than a workout. This ride is designed to train your nervous system, not just your legs. You’ll practice moving from high-output effort (sympathetic “fight or flight”) into controlled downregulation (parasympathetic “rest and restore”).  This contrast builds resiliency—the body’s ability to recover quickly, regulate stress, and return to balance. You’ll leave not just stronger, but more adaptable—better equipped to handle life on and off the bike.
